precondition: Test build of frontend + backend; Organizer, Member and Administrator accounts supplied by QA lead; meetings in several statuses and months for the Organizer; Chrome and a second browser for the two-user cases; Excel.

cases.description: Report opens from the sidebar with the key figures and the query table.
procedure: Sign in as any internal user and click "Báo cáo" in the sidebar.
expected: The browser opens /mgmt/reports; backend answers GET /api/reports/meetings with 200 for the default twelve months and GET /api/reports/query with 200 for the default table (entity=meetings, grouped by month).
Title "Báo cáo" with the button "Xuất Excel"; pickers "Từ" and "đến" show "Tháng MM/yyyy" of the month twelve months ago and the current month.

The band "Số liệu chính" shows the seven manager figures ("Đã họp", "Sắp họp", "Đã huỷ", "Tỷ lệ có mặt", "Thông qua", "Biên bản ban hành", "Giờ ghi âm"); the panel "Truy vấn báo cáo" shows "Dữ liệu", "Nhóm theo" and "Hiển thị" with the month table and "Số liệu lúc <time>".
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an active internal user who can read meetings in the last twelve months.
cases.note: UC-70a | BR-432 | Manual only · Rewritten for the reworked screen (7afa5aa0); rerun needed (evidence 22/11 shows the old cards).

cases.description: The default query table groups meetings by month with figures, bars and a total.
procedure: Read the "Truy vấn báo cáo" table.
expected: "Dữ liệu" reads "Cuộc họp", "Nhóm theo" reads "Tháng" and "Hiển thị" reads "Tất cả"; one row per month (01/2026, 02/2026, 03/2026) with "Số cuộc họp" and the other figures, a bar for the biggest count, and a footer row "Tổng".
A month with no meeting shows a dimmed 0; no meeting title, id or participant is shown when grouped by month.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an Organizer with meetings in 01/2026–03/2026.
cases.note: UC-70a | BR-152 | Manual only · Rewritten for the reworked screen (7afa5aa0); rerun needed (evidence 22/11 shows the old cards).

cases.description: The key-figures band shows the seven manager numbers over the readable meetings.
expected: Rows "Đã họp", "Sắp họp" and "Đã huỷ" with counts; "Tỷ lệ có mặt" (for example "87,3 %") or "Chưa có"; "Thông qua" with "<passed>/<closed> biểu quyết"; "Biên bản ban hành" with "<n> chờ duyệt" when any waits; "Giờ ghi âm" with "<n> gỡ băng".
Every figure counts only the meetings the viewer may read.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an Organizer with Ended meetings, some with attendance and issued minutes.
cases.note: UC-70a | BR-151 | Manual only · Rewritten for the reworked screen (7afa5aa0); rerun needed (evidence 22/11 shows the old cards).

cases.description: Changing a month updates the URL and the figures, and survives a reload.
expected: The URL becomes /mgmt/reports?from=<yyyy-MM>&to=<yyyy-MM> without adding a history entry; figures refresh with the previous ones dimmed while loading.
After the reload the same period and figures are shown.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an active internal user.

cases.description: Report shows an error with a retry button when the backend fails.
procedure: Open /mgmt/reports while the report request fails (QA lead stops the database, or the response is overridden with 500/MSG464 in the browser).
Restore the backend, then click "Thử lại".
expected: Backend answers 500/MSG464; a red alert "Không tải được báo cáo. Vui lòng thử lại." with the button "Thử lại" replaces the figures.
After "Thử lại" the figures load.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
QA lead can stop and start the database of the test build.

cases.description: Report counts only the meetings the viewer may read.
procedure: As user A (Organizer) open /mgmt/reports?from=2026-01&to=2026-12 and note "<n> cuộc họp".
As user B, who is on none of A's meetings, open the same URL.
expected: A sees A's meetings counted; B sees only the meetings B can read, so a Draft meeting of A is in A's total but not B's.
The Administrator also sees only the meetings the Administrator can read.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Two accounts supplied by QA lead in two browsers; A has Draft meetings B cannot read.
cases.note: UC-70a | BR-432 | Manual only · Round1 Passed (2026-11-22): AC5: tests/qa/out/SCRUM-202/20261122-132744-39c00e3b/report.html

cases.description: Report is reachable without any capability, and a Guest cannot use it.
procedure: Sign in as a Member with no administrative capability and click "Báo cáo".
Using the Guest token of an invitation link, request GET /api/reports/meetings.
expected: Step 1: the page opens and loads figures.
Step 2: the backend answers 403 with no message code; a Guest has no internal account and no report.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
A Member account and a Guest invitation link.
cases.note: UC-70a | BR-432 | Manual only · Evidence(AC5, re-run 24/11): tests/qa/out/SCRUM-202/20261124-042226-b5224b3f/report.html and summary.md (organizer +1 Draft/Secret, admin/member unchanged, cancel moves Nháp→Đã huỷ)

cases.description: Changing the data, grouping and display updates the table and the URL, and survives a reload.
procedure: In "Dữ liệu" choose "Biểu quyết", in "Nhóm theo" choose "Kết luận", in "Hiển thị" choose "5 nhóm đầu".
expected: The table regroups by vote conclusion with its figures; the URL keeps entity=votes, the grouping, the sort and top=5 without adding a history entry.
After the reload the same table is shown; "Nhóm theo" lists only the groupings the table has.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an Organizer with votes in the period.

cases.description: Filters narrow the table and can be cleared one by one or all at once.
procedure: In "Trạng thái cuộc họp" choose "Đã kết thúc".
Click "Xoá lọc", then filter again and click "Xoá bộ lọc" in the empty message.
expected: The table shows only Ended meetings and the URL keeps the filter; "Xoá lọc" removes every filter and the full table returns.
With a filter that matches nothing the panel shows "Không có dữ liệu khớp bộ lọc." with "Xoá bộ lọc", which also restores the table.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an Organizer with meetings in several statuses.

cases.description: Sorting reorders the table and a long grouping is cut with a count.
procedure: Open /mgmt/reports with "Dữ liệu" = "Cuộc họp" and "Nhóm theo" = "Chủ toạ".
Click the "Số cuộc họp" header, then the group header.
In "Hiển thị" choose "5 nhóm đầu" on a grouping with more than five groups.
expected: Clicking a figure header sorts biggest first with a pressed sort button and the bar follows the sorted figure; clicking the group header restores the natural order.
The table shows five rows with "5 / <n> nhóm"; grouping by "Từng cuộc họp" names each meeting as a link the viewer may open.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an Organizer with meetings chaired by several people.
